title: Backend Core Version Contract Consumer Hardening
summary: Backend commit 6c3331217b509fc635ad25b71fba503ff066cd72 wraps the Core-owned version capability and retirement-inventory facts, exposes a Backend consumer inventory classifying imported, wrapped, retained, deleted, and blocked version facts, and moves the migration result target to a Core-derived helper while preserving Backend revision and persistence ownership.
expectedOutput: A Backend-owned implementation patch or bounded blocker that prevents Core version capability drift, keeps revision/persistence behavior Backend-owned, removes or records copied Core version facts, and returns fresh Backend evidence for Project Control.
riskSummary: Backend broad truth remains unknown; this lane only hardens the version capability consumer surface. Remaining retained literals are Backend persistence/fixture outcome checks, not broad service readiness or Editor compatibility evidence.
